pages.text: The $(item)Engine Controller$() lets you drive an engine like a vehicle instead of with redstone. A $(item)Transmission$() is the link between the two.

1. Right-click the engine controller with the transmission. Its tooltip now shows the linked controller. Sneak-right-click in the air to clear the link.$(br)2. Right-click the engine with the linked transmission. It mounts as the engine's upgrade and binds the engine to the controller.
The controller's goggles then show $(item)Engine: x y z$() and whether the engine is running; the engine's goggles show $(item)Controller: x y z$(). A controller with no engine says how to link one.

While a controller drives it, the engine $(item)ignores redstone$(). Take the transmission off with a wrench to go back to redstone control: the item you get back keeps its link, so you can mount it again later without re-binding.
Right-click the controller with a wrench to open its menu and set redstone link frequencies.
The items this page talks about. Hover for details; JEI shows their recipes.
